platforms.title: Show HN: DSH plugin that moves a workspace to the top in one click
platforms.text:
Observation first, tool second.

DSH's workspace menu gives you "move up one". I keep nineteen workspaces, and the one I want is usually around eleventh. So getting it to the top costs eleven clicks — and the menu item was clearly designed for "I'm one slot away", not for "I want the top".

I also had the wrong mental model for a week: I thought I wanted pinning. Pinning (where a client ships it) is a separate block that keeps the top forever. What I actually want is "front today, then drift down as I work". Those are different products, and the second one is a one-shot write to the natural order.

So this does exactly one thing: adds "move to top" to the workspace menu, writes the order once through the host's own workspaceRegistry.insertBefore, and leaves the rest draggable. No favourites, no pinning, no background re-sort pass, nothing to configure. 17.5 KB unpacked, 11 files, zero runtime dependencies, MIT.

Honest limits, because they matter more than the feature:
- The host exposes no menu-extension slot for workspaces, so the item is injected into the menu DOM. If a DSH update changes that structure, the item disappears. Documented, not hidden.
- Node tests can't replace real Electron DOM verification; I re-checked the menu on 0.2.2-rc.1 by hand.
- It's DSH-only. Nothing here is useful in VS Code or Cursor.

Install: `dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-workspace-move-top@0.2.2`
Page: https://dongsheng123132.github.io/media-publish/move-top/
Code: https://github.com/dongsheng123132/workspace-hub/tree/main/plugins/dsh-workspace-move-top

Curious how others handle sidebar ordering at this size: auto-sort by last-used, a separate pinned block, or free drag? At nineteen workspaces I found auto-sort actively unhelpful — the workspace I want is often one I haven't touched today.

platforms.text:
`dsh-plugin-workspace-move-top` is a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that adds a "move to top" item to the workspace menu: one click puts a workspace at the top of the sidebar, and the rest of the order stays draggable. Install: `dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-workspace-move-top@0.2.2`.

Why this exists: the menu only ships "move up one". At 19 workspaces that's 11 clicks today and 11 again tomorrow.

Why not pinning: pinning is a separate block that keeps the top forever. Most days I only want "front today".

platforms.title: Move up one vs move to top: a sidebar-ordering design note
platforms.text:
Every workspace sidebar ships "move up one". Almost none ship "move to top".

At 19 workspaces, "move up one" is a keyboard fallback for dragging — it assumes you are one slot away. You are not; you want the top.

I shipped a 17.5 KB DSH plugin that does the one-shot write (through the host's own order API) and nothing else: no favourites, no pinning, no background re-sort.

`dsh-plugin-workspace-move-top` is a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that adds a "move to top" item to the workspace menu: one click puts a workspace at the top of the sidebar, and the rest of the order stays draggable. Install: `dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-workspace-move-top@0.2.2`.

Known limit: the host has no menu-extension slot, so the item is DOM-injected.

platforms.title: 分享一个 DSH 插件：把工作区一次性移到最上面
platforms.text:
「工作区移到最上面」（dsh-plugin-workspace-move-top）是一个 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）桌面端插件：在工作区菜单里加一项「移到最上面」，把某个工作区一次性提到侧栏第一位，之后仍可自由拖动。安装：`dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-workspace-move-top@0.2.2`。

为什么做：官方菜单只有「上移一格」，19 个工作区时今天按 11 次、明天再按 11 次。

为什么不做成置顶：置顶是另一条固定列表，会一直占着最上面；多数时候我只要「今天在最前」。

诚实边界：宿主没给工作区菜单留扩展位，这一项是注入 DOM 的，宿主改菜单结构后可能不出现；只支持 DSH 0.2.x。

https://dongsheng123132.github.io/media-publish/move-top/
platforms.tips: V2EX 只认「自己做的 + 讲清楚」；别发广告腔，别在标题里堆关键词。
